_comment: Structured gateway log events (bridge design 2026-11-13 §13.3 Observability; tracker S2-80). Each event has a tag (the [TAG] prefix kept in `message` for grep), a severity and the ONLY fields it may carry: anything else is dropped, so question text, names and ids stay out by construction. Strings are clipped to max_string_chars. Code refers to events through utils/log_event.js LOG_EVENTS constants, never by string. Cloud Logging query: jsonPayload.tag="BRIDGE_PLAN" AND jsonPayload.event="bridge_plan.decided".
